figurative_meaning_en: sarcastically, in large quantities or abundantly
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা একগঙ্গা, কখনো শেষ হয় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His words are a whole Ganga, they never end.
The market is flooded with fruits, a whole Ganga of them.
history: References the vastness of the Ganga river, symbolizing endless flow in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom leverages the sacred and immense nature of the Ganga for emphasis on quantity.
